lcc_original: 挪亞就這樣行；凡上帝所吩咐他的、他都照樣行了。
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: different Chinese terms for the same Hebrew אֱלֹהִים, SN transfer is unambiguous.
UNV has implicit {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) with no explicit Chinese word; LCC has explicit 他 filling that role, so braces dropped per Rule 3: 他<WAH0853>.
UNV places SN after 吩咐的 as a unit; LCC inserts 他 before 的, so tags split accordingly: 吩咐<WH06680><WTH8765>他<WAH0853>的.
